comments.body: Bethany Seeger: good catch.  I'll add it to the sprint.

Actually this is bigger than original.

I think when I made this for some reason I handled the headers in FedoraVersioning, but for non application/link-format requests I still called addResourceHttpHeaders.

I would suggest that all of this (https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/http/api/FedoraVersioning.java#L252-L261) be moved to where appropriate and this (https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/http/api/FedoraVersioning.java#L284) be moved out of the

if {} else {}

and get called each time and just test for the TimeMap type.
Jared Whiklo Added commit https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1326/commits/73f1d77ba6d9847d86df28404ae842ea431f97ed.
